name: Layby real-engine workloads
description: Replay workloads for engine/replay.py, drawn from the ReturnBench pools (bench/pools, bench/LICENSES.md). Content-free: token counts, gaps, kinds and Layby-Dwell curves. Each file carries the licenses of the pools it draws from. Check: python scripts/verify_manifest.py.

files.build: python engine/build_scaled_workload.py mix36_w0.json 36 0 bench/pools/swechat.json bench/pools/tracelab_claude.json bench/pools/wildchat.json
engine/build_real_workload.py from the real-length pools (bench/REAL_LENGTH.md, bench/build/build_replay_pop.py --no-scale) with their Layby-Dwell curves; see engine/REPRODUCE.md

python engine/build_real_workload.py mix150_real.json 150 --pools swechat.real.json:swechat.real.refs.parquet tracelab_claude.real.json:tracelab_claude.real.refs.parquet wildchat.real.json:wildchat.real.refs.parquet --probs CURVES.parquet (inputs from bench/REAL_LENGTH.md; see engine/REPRODUCE.md)
